title: EPS teachers’ boycott of BEPC practical examination work over unpaid prior-year exam fees
reason: Work/test boycott is reported, but the opened source does not describe an executed public gathering or attendee count. It cannot establish a qualifying >=50 public protest.

title: Mekambo teachers’ threatened road barricade / boycott of Prime Minister’s tour stops
reason: The source explicitly says the threatened action was not carried out after mediation; crowds described elsewhere were welcoming the Prime Minister, not an anti-state protest.
